eyebrow: Room One — after Café Terrace at Night, 1888
title: About me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Koyal. I design things, overthink everything, and romanticize the process.
UI, visuals, ideas, experiments… basically whatever keeps me from having a normal personality.
Still figuring it out. Making it look intentional meanwhile.
My work sits somewhere between design, technology, and the slightly unnecessary urge to make things more interesting than they need to be.
